title: Signature Harbor — What it is
description: Signature Harbor is Manon's original design for visually managing a local AI workstation: every model server, vector database and inference worker runs as a managed container shown on one calm dashboard with logs, GPU stats and one-click restarts. It speaks the Docker API natively but adds Signature lanes: each AI service gets a health contract, automatic log summarization, and a big red 'park everything' button that idles the whole lab. It is made by Signature Systems (Justin Addam Higgins) and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux.
